meta.name: add-karpathy-llm-wiki
meta.description: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", "karpathy wiki".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为群组添加持久化知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在群聊中共享和查询持久化的知识库内容。
copy.tagline_en: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to your group
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to share and query a persistent knowledge base in group chats.

howto.what: 在 NanoClaw 群组中搭建一个常驻 wiki 知识库：创建 wiki/ 与 sources/ 目录、首页和日志，写入维护规则并更新群组说明；之后收到多个文件会逐个读取、总结再整理成 wiki 页面。
howto.when: 当你说出「add wiki」「wiki」「knowledge base」等关键词，或明示要添加一个 wiki 知识库时触发。

say.text: 给这个群添加一个 wiki
say.note: 开始建库，会问选哪个群、主题和结构。

say.text: 新建一个专门群放 wiki 知识库
say.note: 它会引导注册新群并创建目录。

say.text: 把 wiki 设成每周自动检查一次

howto.what_en: Adds a persistent wiki to a NanoClaw group: creates wiki/ and sources/ folders, index and log, writes maintenance rules, updates group description, and ingests multiple files one-by-one into wiki pages.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", or ask to add a wiki knowledge base.

say_en.text: Add a wiki to this group
say_en.note: Starts setup, asks which group and topic.

say_en.text: Make a new dedicated group for the wiki
say_en.note: Guides you through registering and creating folders.

say_en.text: Set the wiki to auto-check weekly
